title: Escape-Proof Join
prompt: Implement safe_join(base: str, user_path: str) that joins base with user_path and raises ValueError if the resolved result escapes base (classic directory-traversal defense). Return the joined Path on success.

tests.name: normal subpath allowed
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
result = safe_join('/srv/data', 'reports/q1.csv')
assert str(result).endswith('reports/q1.csv')

tests.name: traversal attempt rejected
tests.hint: resolve() collapses '..' — then verify the result is under the resolved base.
